findings.observedInSource: Launcher comment cites full log decompression/materialization peak and sets runner NODE_OPTIONS max-old-space-size=4096. readStableFile reads full compressed bytes, readZstdPrefix iterates frames but SessionLogScanner retains all decoded events; prepareCore adopts/validates full events and constructs prepared Session. findings.recommendedBoundary: First compare optimized TS/native codec algorithm: revision-bound frame/seq index, bounded stable reads, read-only event range/iterator with admitted limits, generation-bound DTO and cancellation. Keep whole-prefix corruption/seq/torn-tail validation and authority semantics. Native/API pagination or index observation must actually consume the bounded interface; replacing only scanner with Rust leaves full materialization intact. Live Session resume may intentionally require full authoritative history and needs separate lazy/compacted representation design.
findings.existingMitigation: readFirstZstdLine reads only first header frame. Query SQLite reuses unchanged indexed revisions and shadows persisted rows with live sessions. Projection cache skips folded prefix but not cold event materialization.
